name: cec
description: Una aplicacion para gestion cursos, realizado con angular y laravel

scripts.dcdestruir: docker compose down && sudo rm -rf data/
scripts.chmod-backend: docker compose exec php chmod -R gu+w . && docker compose exec php chmod -R guo+w .
scripts.chmod-frontend: docker compose exec vite chmod -R gu+w . && docker compose exec vite chmod -R guo+w .
scripts.chmods: npm run chmod-backend && npm run chmod-frontend
scripts.install-dependencies: npm run install-dependencies-front && npm run install-dependencies-back
scripts.install-dependencies-front: docker compose run --rm vite npm install
scripts.test: docker compose exec php php artisan test

author: Alejandro Valenzuela
